sections.title: We prepare your engineering organization to build software with AI.
sections.lead: AI changed what it costs to write code. Everything else does not change on its own: architecture, people, process and team structure. We support that transformation across four fronts that can be engaged separately or as a single program.

sections.title: Four fronts, one transformation.
sections.text: Each front can be engaged on its own. Together they cover what changes when an organization starts building with AI agents.

items.title: Architecture and complex systems
items.text: Architecture decisions that withstand change, and systems that are understood before they are built.
items: Advisory on architecture, integration and platform evolution
Conception, specification and design of complex systems
Domain-driven design and Event Storming workshops

items.title: Training and technical leadership
items.text: Roles change when agents execute; human judgment becomes what is valuable.
items: Role-based training: Tech Lead, AI-native Engineer, Product Owner and QA
Development of technical leaders and engineering managers

items.title: SDLC modernization with TELAR
items.text: A governed lifecycle for building software with AI agents, adopted in phases and backed by evidence.
items: Adoption package by area or domain
Ongoing support and evolution of the agent environment

items.title: Optimization and design of software delivery teams
items.text: Structures, accountabilities and controls tailored to the new way of building.
items: Engineering team design and career paths

action.label: Enquire →
action.href: mail:Optimization and design of software delivery teams

sections.title: Four ways to work together.
sections.text: Any front can be engaged in the model that best fits your moment: from an assessment of a few weeks to ongoing technology leadership.

items.title: Strategic assessment
items.text: An in-depth review of engineering practices and AI readiness, with a transformation roadmap.

items.title: Project-based
items.text: Fixed-scope engagements —an MVP built with the SPIRAL method, an architecture design or an AI integration— with clear deliverables and timelines.

items.title: Implementation support
items.text: Working side by side to introduce agent workflows, put TELAR in place and drive organizational change.

items.title: Fractional CTO
items.text: Technology leadership for startups and scaling companies: strategic guidance, architecture decisions and team coaching.

sections.eyebrow: The method behind the four fronts
sections.title: TELAR connects technology, people, tools and organization.
sections.text: Every front starts in the same place: a maturity assessment that shows where each area of your portfolio stands, which gaps matter most and where to begin. From there, every service applies the same method.

paragraphs: The complete method, published under a CC BY 4.0 license, free to read, cite and adapt. The method is public; our work is to put it in place in your organization.

sections.bio: More than twenty-five years building, scaling and transforming engineering organizations: from a software factory grown from 3 to more than 165 people, to AI agent adoption at a digital insurer.
